shots.name: Shooter Lane
shots.notes: Manual plunger. The basic skill shot lights one of the three R.I.P. lanes at random — lane-change it before the ball leaves. Hold the left flipper while plunging instead and the ball routes around the left loop for the Super Skill Shot.

shots.name: Left Flipper
shots.notes: Feeds the left loop, left ramp and Left Stand-Up. Hold it down while plunging to route the Super Skill Shot around the loop instead of straight into a normal skill shot lane.

shots.name: Right Flipper
shots.notes: Feeds the right loop, right ramp and the safe. Also one of the two buttons that fold or bet during the Executive Game video mode.

shots.name: Left Inlane
shots.notes: One of four lanes that spell F-I-S-H toward the saucer's next mystery award — this one lights the I.

shots.name: Left Outlane
shots.notes: One of four lanes that spell F-I-S-H toward the saucer's next mystery award — this one lights the F.

shots.name: Right Inlane
shots.notes: One of four lanes that spell F-I-S-H toward the saucer's next mystery award.

shots.name: Right Outlane
shots.notes: One of four lanes that spell F-I-S-H toward the saucer's next mystery award.

shots.name: Fish
shots.notes: An eject saucer on the far left with a talking fish mounted above it. Spell F-I-S-H across all four inlanes and outlanes to light it; the mystery award scales with how far along the game you are.

shots.name: Left Loop
shots.notes: Linked with the right loop for Truck Heist — a shot to either one advances both. Carries one of the four Advance Rank envelopes and doubles as one of the five arrow shots used across the episodes.

shots.name: Left Ramp
shots.notes: Always returns down the left inlane. Three shots start Bing Multiball's Party at the Bing challenge, and it carries an Advance Rank envelope of its own.

shots.name: Left Stand-Up
shots.notes: Sits between the left loop and the left ramp. A direct hit toward spelling SOPRANOS.

shots.name: Safe Stand-Up
shots.notes: Sits beside the safe. Works the same as the Left Stand-Up for spelling SOPRANOS.

shots.name: Spinner
shots.notes: Sits directly in front of the inner loop, so every inner loop shot spins it on the way through. Worth 10K to start, climbing 1K per spin to a 100K cap, and resets after a few idle seconds.

shots.name: Inner Loop
shots.notes: The cash-in point for a spelled SOPRANOS, a lit Advance Rank, and a lit Pork Store award. Also one of the five arrow shots shared across the episodes and the finishing shot for three of them.

shots.name: The Safe
shots.notes: The machine's centerpiece toy. Takes three hits to crack open the first time, one more than the last every time after — and it's also one of the six shots that can spell UNDERBOSS.

shots.name: Safe Saucer
shots.notes: Opens up once the safe cracks. A shot in here closes the safe back up and banks the award.

shots.name: Stugots Drop Target
shots.notes: Blocks the entrance to the Stugots. Has to be knocked down before a shot into the lock actually counts, and later becomes a jackpot target of its own.

shots.name: The Stugots
shots.notes: The mini-ramp lock for Stugots Multiball, and later a target for its double and super jackpots. Also one of the three lock shots during Underboss Multiball.

shots.name: R.I.P. Lanes
shots.notes: Three rollover lanes above the pop bumpers. Completing all three raises the bonus multiplier, and the first one is where the basic plunger skill shot lands.

shots.name: Pop Bumpers
shots.notes: Fed from either loop or off the safe. Every hit counts toward Shake Down, and during Truck Heist the first two loop shots drop the ball in here as well.

shots.name: Right Ramp
shots.notes: Known in-game as the Meadowlands. A loop-style ramp that needs real speed to make; its entrance doubles as the pop bumpers' exit, and it carries the fourth Advance Rank envelope.

shots.name: Right Loop
shots.notes: Linked with the left loop for Truck Heist. Carries an Advance Rank envelope and doubles as one of the five arrow shots.

shots.name: Pork Store Targets
shots.notes: Two stand-up targets just under the right loop. Hit either one to light a Pork Store mystery award at the inner loop.

goals.title: Plunger Skill Shot
goals.summary: The plunger skill shot lights one of the three R.I.P. rollovers before the ball leaves the shooter lane — lane-change it to the one you want, then land there. It also spots one of the eight backpanel characters toward your bonus multiplier.

steps.action: Plunge to the flashing R.I.P. lane
steps.detail: One of the three rollovers blinks before the ball leaves the shooter lane; use the flipper buttons to lane-change it to whichever one you want first. The first skill shot pays 500K and spots a backpanel character toward your bonus multiplier; every skill shot after the first adds another 250K.

goals.title: Super Skill Shot
goals.summary: Hold the left flipper while you plunge and the ball loops around and comes back to your flippers instead of heading for a normal skill shot lane. Whatever you hit within the next few seconds decides the bonus on top of the base value.
goals.reward: 500K+, plus a mode or multiball head start

steps.action: Hold the left flipper and plunge
steps.detail: Routes the ball around the left loop and back to your flippers automatically instead of the usual skill shot lane — no aiming needed for this part — and you have roughly five seconds to shoot again once it returns.

steps.action: Follow up on the inner loop
steps.detail: This lights or starts an episode on top of the base 500K super skill shot value. The other live options in that window: the left ramp starts Bing, the safe only pays the flat super value, the far ramp banks three ramp hits at once, and the far loop jumps straight into a hurry-up.

goals.title: Spell SOPRANOS
goals.summary: Spinning the spinner or clipping either stand-up target spells letters toward SOPRANOS; get the whole word and the inner loop lights to start an episode.

steps.action: Spin the spinner for quick letters
steps.detail: Each spin adds toward the word on top of its own cash value, which starts at 10K and climbs 1K per spin up to a 100K cap; it resets if the spinner sits idle for a few seconds.

steps.action: Or clip the target between the loop and the ramp
steps.detail: A direct hit here adds a letter to the word too, the same as a spin does.

steps.action: This one advances the word too
steps.detail: It sits just beside the safe and works exactly the same as the other stand-up target.

steps.action: Cash in at the inner loop once it's spelled
steps.detail: That shot lights or starts the next episode and can also pay a Fish or Pork Store award on the way. Episodes are exclusive — only one runs at a time — and while you can finish spelling the word during multiball, a new episode only launches in single-ball play. Parking the ball in the pop bumpers pauses whichever episode is already running.

goals.title: Advance Rank
goals.summary: Four envelope inserts sit at the two loops and two ramps. Light all four and the inner loop turns into a rank advance worth a real Tribute payout.

steps.action: Shoot the left loop for an envelope
steps.detail: Envelopes pay 50K on the first pass, +5K each time after.

steps.action: Match it on the right loop
steps.detail: Same value ladder as the other three envelope shots.

steps.action: Add the left ramp
steps.detail: Three down, one to go.

steps.action: And the right ramp completes the set
steps.detail: The Fish saucer can also spot an envelope for you if one of these four is proving stubborn.

steps.action: Cash them in at the inner loop
steps.detail: With all four lit, the inner loop advances your rank and pays a 500K Tribute, +100K for every rank after. Once you reach Underboss the envelopes stay lit permanently, and every hit pays a 750K (+50K) Tribute to Underboss, capped at 1M, that carries for the rest of the game.

goals.title: The Rank Ladder
goals.summary: Every rank you earn arms its own scoring doubler for the rest of that ball, on a ladder that runs from Associate all the way to Underboss.
instructions: Every rank pairs with a scoring doubler that runs for the rest of the ball you earn it on: Associate arms Double Shakedown, Soldier arms Double Safe, Good Earner arms Double Truck Heist.
Acting Capo lights an extra ball instead of a doubler.
Capo arms Double Meadowlands, Consigliere arms Double Episode scoring, and Underboss starts the Underboss multiball outright.
Underboss is as far as the normal rank ladder goes — reaching Boss takes clearing a separate checklist, not just more rank-ups.
Rank climbs from either the inner loop, once all four envelopes are lit, or from closing the safe — keep both options in mind if one side of the playfield is running hot.

goals.title: Crack The Safe
goals.summary: The safe is the machine's biggest toy — pound on it until it cracks, then finish the job at the saucer behind it to close it back up and bank the reward.
goals.reward: 500K to crack, up to 2.5M to close

steps.action: Pound the safe open
steps.detail: It takes three hits to crack it the first time, then one more hit than the last every time after. Cracking it scores 500K, +50K each time you do it again.

steps.action: Drop the ball into the saucer behind it
steps.detail: That closes the safe back up for 1.25M, +75K per repeat, capped at 2.5M, and advances your rank on top of the score. The whole award doubles once you're ranked Soldier.

goals.title: Shake Down
goals.summary: Shake Down runs the whole game in the background, tallying up pop bumper hits toward a completion bonus that gets tougher — and richer — every time you clear it.

steps.action: Rattle around in the pop bumpers
steps.detail: The first pass needs 25 pop hits, each paying 10K toward it. Both numbers climb on repeat passes — 5 more hits needed each time, 1K more per pop.

steps.action: Keep feeding them for the completion bonus
steps.detail: Finishing a pass pays a 50K bonus that also climbs, up to a 150K cap, and bumps the spinner's base value by 10K. The whole thing doubles once you're ranked Associate.

goals.title: Truck Heist
goals.summary: Two setup shots on either loop lead into a real hurry-up on the third — and that third shot changes where the ball goes next, so be ready.

steps.action: Work either loop to build it up
steps.detail: Left and right loops are linked — a shot to one also advances the other. The first shot pays 125K; both of the first two drop the ball into the pop bumpers.

steps.action: A third loop shot starts the hurry-up
steps.detail: That one pays 175K and, unlike the first two, sends the ball back down toward your flippers instead of into the bumpers — be ready for it.

steps.action: Shoot a loop again to collect
steps.detail: The hurry-up opens at 750K and climbs 75K every time you complete one later in the game. It's doubled once you're ranked Good Earner, and Boss Mode needs four completed heists on the books before it will even light.

goals.title: Meadowlands Ramp
goals.summary: The right ramp needs real speed to clear, and rewards you for it with a four-stage award ladder that resets and grows every time you run it.

steps.action: Ride the right ramp with power
steps.detail: It's a loop-style ramp, so a soft shot won't make it around — you need both accuracy and speed. Its entrance also doubles as the pop bumpers' exit, so expect traffic there during other modes.

steps.action: Keep shooting it to climb the ladder
steps.detail: Four awards light in order — Shovel for 500K, Bowling Bag for 750K, Luggage for 1M, then Trap for 1.25M, which also lights the Meadowlands award tied to Underboss rank. After Trap the ladder restarts, with every lap adding 250K to the base values up to a 2.5M cap. It's doubled once you're ranked Capo, and Boss Mode needs Trap reached four times before it will light.

goals.title: Food Fight
goals.summary: Fifteen hidden dishes are scattered across the two ramps and two loops, waiting behind whatever else isn't currently lit there. Collect them all and every one of those four shots goes hot at once.

steps.action: Watch for a dish award to appear
steps.detail: The two ramps and two loops each carry a food insert, but only two are lit at once — and only when nothing else, like an envelope or a hurry-up, is lit there instead.

steps.action: Collect all fifteen dishes across the four shots
steps.detail: It doesn't matter which shots you use to get there, only that the running total reaches fifteen.

steps.action: Food Fight starts the instant the last dish lands
steps.detail: All four shots light at once for 100K-150K apiece with a 30-second clock running; missing the timer or losing the ball ends it early.

goals.title: Arson
goals.summary: Bucco's place is on fire — take out all four flickering shots in any order, then finish it at the inner loop before the 30-second clock runs out.
goals.reward: 500K to 1.25M per shot, 2.5M to finish, 6.25M total

steps.action: Take out all four lit shots
steps.detail: Arson lights the two ramps and two loops at once, flickering like fire. Each one you hit shuts off and knocks out that flame; the order doesn't matter, and the value climbs with every hit — 500K, then 750K, 1M, and 1.25M for the fourth.

steps.action: Finish at the inner loop
steps.detail: That's the last flame — the fire's out, and you collect 2.5M more for a full episode worth 6.25M including the 250K you get just for starting it. The whole thing has to happen inside 30 seconds.

goals.title: Exterminate
goals.summary: A single lit arrow walks you through all four outer shots one at a time, then the inner loop wraps it up.
goals.reward: 500K to 575K per shot, 600K to finish, 3M total

steps.action: Follow the single lit arrow
steps.detail: Only one of the four outer shots is lit at a time here — hit it to light the next in line. The four hits pay 500K, 525K, 550K, then 575K.

steps.action: Finish by hitting the inner loop
steps.detail: That's where the bug actually turns up, worth 600K on top of everything else, for a 3M episode total inside 30 seconds.

goals.title: Horse Race
goals.summary: All five arrows go live for a 30-second sprint — clear as many as you can, then cross the line at the inner loop for a payout based on where you finished.
goals.reward: 250K for last up to 4M for first

steps.action: Clear the lit arrows before time runs out
steps.detail: All five outer shots start lit for Horse Race; each one you hit knocks a rival out of the race, and clearing one flips the rest of the lit arrows to the opposite side, so you're alternating left and right rather than leaning on one.

steps.action: Cross the line at the inner loop
steps.detail: The inner loop is the finishing shot — hitting it ends the race for you, and your place decides the payout: 4M for first, down through 3M, 2.125M, 1.375M, and 750K, to 250K for last.

goals.title: Executive Game
goals.summary: A hand of video-mode poker where you're the better hand and the game plays the worse one — fold and walk away, or bet and see where the cards go.
goals.reward: Win or lose points on the bet

steps.action: Fold with the left flipper button
steps.detail: Executive Game is a video-mode hand of hold 'em — you hold the upper hand, the game plays the lower. Folding costs you the pot but ends the hand safely.

steps.action: Or bet with the right flipper button
steps.detail: A bet costs 140K up front, and what you win or lose after that depends on your cards, the pot size, and how far along the game already is — no two hands play out the same.

goals.title: Satisfaction
goals.summary: All five arrows stay lit for the entire 30 seconds here, so you can lean on whichever shot you're most confident in instead of chasing a fixed order.

steps.action: Lean on whichever lit arrow you like
steps.detail: Unlike the timed episodes with a fixed shot order, Satisfaction leaves all five arrows live for the full 30 seconds, so you can hammer whichever one you're most accurate on.

steps.action: Five hits anywhere finish it
steps.detail: The value climbs every hit — 500K, 750K, 1M, 1.25M, then 1.5M on the fifth — for 5.25M if you clear all five inside the 30-second clock.

goals.title: Stugots Multiball
goals.summary: Knock down the drop target and lock two balls in the Stugots to get this one started, then work the drop target and the boat itself for jackpots that only get bigger.

steps.action: Knock down the drop target to light a lock
steps.detail: It sits in front of the Stugots and has to go down before a locked ball counts. Sneaking a ball into the Stugots while it's still up only pays a 250K Quickie Bonus and gets spat back out — though it does light the next lock for you.

steps.action: Lock two balls to start multiball
steps.detail: The drop target has to be knocked down again between locks. A ball saver covers you the moment it starts.

steps.action: Work the drop target for jackpots
steps.detail: Every hit is a jackpot starting at 1M, +25K each time, no matter which multiball number this is. After three hits it stays down for good.

steps.action: Bash the Stugots itself for the big ones
steps.detail: Once the target's down for good, one hit is a 2.15M double jackpot and two hits is a 3.225M super. After the super, all five arrows light for jackpots too, starting at a raised 1.1M each — clear all five and the drop target resets for another round.

steps.action: Shoot a lit Fish for an extra ball
steps.detail: Works once per multiball, and it's one of the few times Add-A-Ball shows up as a Fish award here.

goals.title: Bing Multiball
goals.summary: Three left ramp shots start a 30-second switch-hitting sprint; clear the target and the multiball starts on the spot.

steps.action: Hit the left ramp three times
steps.detail: That starts Party at the Bing, a 30-second switch-hit challenge. The first time you need 75 total switch hits to clear it; every attempt after raises the target by 25, though unfinished progress carries over to your next try.

steps.action: Rack up switches fast in the bumpers
steps.detail: Anything counts toward the total — bumpers, the spinner, targets, rollovers. The left ramp itself is worth 10 switch hits on its own during the party, and a lit Fish can award another 10.

steps.action: Clearing the target starts multiball immediately
steps.detail: Bing Multiball runs three balls with every shot lit for a jackpot that opens at 125K and climbs 5K per hit up to a 250K cap — no doubles or supers here, and it resets to 125K the next time you start it.

steps.action: Shoot a lit Fish for an extra ball
steps.detail: Works once per multiball. It ends once you're down to one ball or the ball drains twice.

goals.title: Underboss Multiball
goals.summary: Reach Underboss rank and this one's waiting for you — spell UNDERBOSS across the arrows and the safe, then lock up to three balls for a payout that multiplies with every lock.

steps.action: Work the inner loop into your letter count
steps.detail: UNDERBOSS takes nine hits total, spread across all five arrow shots plus the safe, in any order. This multiball only becomes available once you've actually reached Underboss rank.

steps.action: The safe counts toward the letters too
steps.detail: Every hit toward UNDERBOSS pays its own jackpot, starting at 350K and climbing 75K each time you add a letter.

steps.action: Lock in at any of the three lit spots
steps.detail: Once UNDERBOSS is fully spelled, the Stugots lights for lock along with two other shots elsewhere on the playfield, worth 250K (+75K climbing) apiece — reach them in whatever order you like. The first lock pays that value once, the second triples it, and a third quintuples it.

steps.action: Watch how the outer loops behave here
steps.detail: Unlike every other multiball on this machine, a ball shot up one outer loop comes back down the opposite loop to your flippers instead of dropping into the pop bumpers — left and right both work this way, so don't get caught flat-footed on either side.

goals.title: Fish Mystery Award
goals.summary: The Fish saucer on the far left pays out an award that fits wherever you are in the game — spell F-I-S-H across all four in/outlanes, then feed it.

steps.action: Roll through all four lanes to spell F-I-S-H
steps.detail: Each of the four lanes lights one letter — the left outlane lights the F, the left inlane the I — and the saucer stays dark until the whole word is spelled.

steps.action: Drop into the Fish saucer while it's lit
steps.detail: It always gives you something that matches where you are in the game: a spotted envelope toward Advance Rank, a Truck Heist value reset, 10 Bing switch hits, one more backpanel character toward R.I.P., 10 extra seconds on a running episode, or — during multiball only, once per multiball — an extra ball.

goals.title: Pork Store
goals.summary: Two stand-ups under the right loop light a genuine grab-bag award, collected back at the inner loop.
goals.reward: One of a dozen-plus possible awards

steps.action: Light it from the two white stand-ups
steps.detail: They sit just under the right loop — hit either one to arm the award.

steps.action: Collect it through the inner loop
steps.detail: The award is a genuine grab bag: it can advance Truck Heist, Meadowlands, or Food Fight progress outright, bump your rank, add to or hold your spinner value, spot an R.I.P. character, instantly crack the safe, light or award a lock, light an extra ball or a Special, pay a flat 500K — or, rarely, hand you a much bigger jolt of points and a short frenzy of its own.

goals.title: The Rare Frenzy Award
goals.summary: The rarest thing the Pork Store can hand you — a flat 3M and a short frenzy where every switch on the table pays real money.
instructions: This is the rarest of the Pork Store's grab-bag awards, and nothing warns you it's coming — you just get 3M and the mode starts on the spot.
Once it hits, every switch across the whole playfield pays 30K for 30 seconds, so it rewards whatever you were already doing more than any one specific shot.
The strongest play is to get into a multiball as fast as possible while it's running — more balls in play means more switches hit before the 30 seconds run out.

goals.title: Boss Mode
goals.summary: Boss Mode is the actual finish line of the game — nine separate tasks light it at the inner loop, then winning it takes an eight-stage gauntlet through the whole game again, in a fixed order.
goals.reward: Millions per stage, culminating in a full run

steps.action: Open with Food
steps.detail: All four ramps and loops light for food value; four hits in a row are worth roughly 3M, 3.19M, 3.38M and 3.56M.

steps.action: Move on to Meadowlands
steps.detail: Three ramp shots worth roughly 4.5M, 5.25M and 6M.

steps.action: Then Truck
steps.detail: Three outer-loop shots worth roughly 1.5M, 1.88M and 2.25M.

steps.action: Then Boat
steps.detail: Three hits on the Stugots worth roughly 750K, 1.5M and 2.25M.

steps.action: Then Bing
steps.detail: Three left ramp shots on the same 750K, 1.5M, 2.25M ladder as Boat.

steps.action: Then R.I.P.
steps.detail: Just one completed pass this time, worth roughly 1.125M — lane change still works if you need it.

steps.action: Then the arrows
steps.detail: Five shots across the outer loops, ramps and inner loop, each worth a bit more than the last, roughly 2.06M up to 2.81M.

steps.action: Finish at the safe
steps.detail: Seven hits force it open, climbing from roughly 1.125M up to 3.31M on the last hit before it pops — clear that and the whole run resets to do it all again, since Boss Mode only ends when you actually lose all four balls. A lit Fish always pays Add-A-Ball here, so spell it again through the inlanes and outlanes if you drop to your last ball.

goals.title: What Stacks With What
goals.summary: Know what's allowed to run at once before it costs you: modes and multiball can overlap, but two modes can't, and multiball stacking has one exception around Underboss.
instructions: Modes stack with multiball but never with each other — start an episode first, then a multiball on top of it if you want both running, not two episodes at once.

Multiballs stack with each other, too, but there's one asymmetry: you can launch Underboss on top of an already-running Bing or Stugots multiball, but not the reverse — Bing and Stugots can't be triggered once Underboss is underway.

achievements.title: Made Man's First Shot
achievements.desc: Land the plunger skill shot in the flashing R.I.P. lane.

achievements.title: Around The Horn
achievements.desc: Pull off the hold-flipper Super Skill Shot and follow up inside the window.

achievements.title: S-O-P-R-A-N-O-S
achievements.desc: Spell SOPRANOS and light an episode at the inner loop.

achievements.title: Made Man
achievements.desc: Light all four envelopes and cash in a rank advance at the inner loop.

achievements.title: Crack The Safe
achievements.desc: Crack the safe open and close it back up for the saucer award.

achievements.title: Full Shakedown
achievements.desc: Clear a complete Shake Down pass in the pop bumpers.

achievements.title: Truck Heist
achievements.desc: Start and collect a Truck Heist hurry-up.

achievements.title: The Trap
achievements.desc: Reach Trap on the Meadowlands ramp ladder.

achievements.title: Fifteen Dishes
achievements.desc: Collect all fifteen dishes and clear Food Fight.

achievements.title: Two In The Boat
achievements.desc: Lock two balls and start Stugots Multiball.

achievements.title: Party At The Bing
achievements.desc: Clear a Bing Party challenge and start Bing Multiball.

achievements.title: Underboss
achievements.desc: Reach Underboss rank and start Underboss Multiball.

achievements.title: Jackpot Grab Bag
achievements.desc: Draw the rare frenzy award out of the Pork Store.

achievements.title: Everybody's Waiting
achievements.desc: Complete every prerequisite and light Boss Mode at the inner loop.

achievements.title: Fuhgeddaboudit
achievements.desc: Clear the entire task list a second time as Boss.

drills.title: Super Skill Shot Follow-Up
drills.text: Hold the left flipper as you plunge and the ball rides the left loop back to you on its own — the plunge is not the skill, the next five seconds are. Decide the follow-up before you pull: inner loop to light an episode, left ramp to start Bing, far ramp to bank three ramp hits at once.

drills.title: Meadowlands With Power
drills.text: The right ramp is loop-style, so a soft shot simply will not carry round — this one needs speed as well as line. Shoot it from a cradle at full strength and stay alert at its entrance, because the pop bumpers empty out there.

drills.title: Crack It, Then Close It
drills.text: Pound the safe until it cracks, then put the ball into the saucer behind it rather than wandering off to something else. Cracking it is the cheap half; the close is what banks the money and advances your rank.

drills.title: Truck Heist Third Shot
drills.text: Either loop advances both, so shoot whichever side is convenient for the first two and expect the ball to end up in the bumpers. The third shot behaves differently — it sends the ball back down at your flippers — so have the collecting loop shot already picked when it comes.

drills.title: Horse Race Alternation
drills.text: Clearing an arrow flips the rest of the lit ones to the opposite side, so plan on alternating left and right instead of leaning on your best shot. Take the inner loop last — it ends the race for you, and your place at that moment is the payout.

drills.title: Underboss Loop Returns
drills.text: In this multiball alone, a ball up one outer loop comes back down the opposite loop and onto your flippers instead of dropping into the pops. Play a whole Underboss deliberately shooting loops so the cross-side return stops surprising you mid-jackpot.

actionButton.how: This is Whitestar-era Stern, a good seven years before a button showed up on the lockdown bar. Two flipper buttons, a shooter rod and your hips are the whole interface — hold the left flipper in as you plunge if you want the super skill shot.

howItPlays.objective: The Sopranos casts you as a mobster climbing the family. Spell SOPRANOS to run episodes, work up the rank ladder, start the three multiballs, and clear the eight-stage Boss Mode gauntlet.
loop: Spin the spinner and clip the two stand-ups to spell SOPRANOS, which lights the inner loop to start an episode.
Light the four envelopes on the loops and ramps, then cash them at the inner loop to climb the rank ladder.
Bank a scoring doubler with every rank while cracking the safe and locking balls for the Stugots and Bing multiballs.
Reach Underboss for its own multiball, then complete nine tasks to light Boss Mode at the inner loop.

lights.name: SOPRANOS Letters
lights.lit: Every spin of the spinner or clip of the two stand-up targets adds a letter toward SOPRANOS, and the spinner pays its own climbing cash on the way through.
lights.then: Finish the word to light the inner loop, then shoot it to launch the next episode; only one episode runs at a time and a fresh one starts only in single-ball play, so bank the word and clear back to one ball first.

lights.name: Episode Arrows
lights.lit: The two loops, two ramps and the inner loop are the five arrow shots every episode is built from, so a lit arrow is a live episode shot and the inner loop is where most episodes finish.
lights.then: Start an episode at the inner loop, take out its lit arrows before the thirty-second clock, and close it at the inner loop; episode scoring doubles once your rank reaches Consigliere.

lights.name: R.I.P. Lanes
lights.lit: A lit R.I.P. lane above the pop bumpers is one you have yet to roll, and completing all three raises your bonus multiplier for the rest of the ball.
lights.flashing: Off the plunge, one R.I.P. lane blinks as the skill-shot target before the ball leaves the shooter lane.

control.effect: a flipper tap shifts the lit R.I.P. lane sideways, so you can slide it under the ball and roll a lane you still need, and off the plunge the same taps line the blinking lane up before the ball drops in
control.when: any time before the ball rolls through the R.I.P. lanes

lights.then: Roll all three lit lanes to step up the bonus multiplier that scales your whole end-of-ball bonus, and a plunger skill shot landed here also lights another of the eight backpanel faces that feed the very same multiplier.

lights.name: Advance Rank Envelopes
lights.lit: An envelope insert rides each loop and each ramp, and lighting all four turns the inner loop into a rank advance that pays a Tribute.
lights.then: Cash the four envelopes at the inner loop to climb from Associate toward Underboss, and each rank you earn arms a scoring doubler for the rest of the ball; closing the cracked safe advances rank as well, and reaching Underboss starts its multiball outright.

lights.name: The Safe
lights.lit: The safe is the centerpiece toy; pound it open in three hits the first time and one more than the last after that, and the saucer behind it opens up.
lights.then: Drop into that open saucer to shut the safe again for a climbing award and a rank bump, and keep in mind the safe is also one of the shots that spell UNDERBOSS.

lights.name: F-I-S-H Lanes
lights.lit: The four inlanes and outlanes each light a letter of F-I-S-H, and the Fish saucer over on the far left stays unlit until you complete the full word.
lights.then: Feed the lit Fish for a mystery award scaled to your progress, whether a spotted envelope, a Truck Heist reset, Bing switch hits, an R.I.P. character, extra episode time, or an extra ball during a multiball.

lights.name: Stugots Lock
lights.lit: Knock the drop target down to light a lock at the Stugots, since a ball snuck past while the target still stands only pays a small Quickie Bonus and gets kicked back out.
lights.then: Lock two balls to start Stugots Multiball, then keep hammering the boat and its guarding drop target for jackpots that grow toward a super, and clearing that lights every arrow shot for jackpots as well.

lights.name: UNDERBOSS Multiball
lights.lit: Once you actually reach Underboss rank, every hit across the five arrows and the safe spells a letter of UNDERBOSS and pays its own climbing jackpot.
lights.then: Spell the whole word to light three lock shots, the Stugots among them, where the first lock scores once, the second triples the value and a third quintuples it, and in this multiball alone a ball sent up one outer loop comes back on the far side to your flippers rather than into the bumpers.

howItPlays.laneChangeNote: Tap either flipper to slide the lit R.I.P. lane above the pop bumpers, moving it under the ball so you roll the lane you still need; off the plunge, the same taps line up the blinking skill-shot lane before the ball leaves the shooter. Complete all three R.I.P. lanes to raise the bonus multiplier that scales your end-of-ball bonus.

scoring.text: Spell SOPRANOS on the spinner and stand-ups to light your first episode at the inner loop, and lane-change the R.I.P. lanes to build your bonus multiplier early. Crack the safe for a steady award and a step toward your first rank.

Light the four envelopes and cash rank advances at the inner loop, since each rank arms a scoring doubler for the ball, and run episodes between the rank-ups. Lock balls for the Stugots and Bing multiballs, and reach Underboss rank to start its own.

Boss Mode is the true finish line: complete its nine prerequisites to light it at the inner loop, then win an eight-stage gauntlet through Food, Meadowlands, Truck, Boat, Bing, R.I.P., the arrows and the safe. It only ends when you lose all four balls, so a lit Fish paying Add-A-Ball can keep the run alive.
